results.label: actual HTML loads the intention view before the dashboard and journal that render it
the card states the saved rule and names the episode’s own anti-example
a day with nothing recorded is not a failure and offers no score
the card offers the editor and the readonly history and states authority:none
no intention is ever carried over or defaulted into today
a past day is readonly: no editor button and no back-filling
a past day keeps its own empty answer rather than borrowing today’s words
the editor offers exactly the four saved process examples
no saved example is preselected — there is no default intention
the neutral state is the trader’s own words with an empty box — no saved example is chosen for them
picking a saved example disables free text and keeps the check the trader made
recording a saved example reports the record and what did NOT change
the recorded day comes back as the saved example with its framing and receipt
choosing your own words re-enables the box and clears every saved example in this editor
the editor refuses a money target in the same sentence and says so
the refused write changed nothing — the saved example is still the day
free text is stored as written and labelled unverified, never process-oriented
the stored free text keeps the trader’s wording, framing and its own warnings
the editor shows the retained records for the day rather than hiding them
reload discards the unsaved draft and re-reads the day from the server
the readonly history modal lists the day’s versions with receipts and says it is not a score
the history modal renders every retained record as data, not as executable markup
the server stored the markup as words and the card renders them as escaped text
no uncaught DOM error was recorded while rendering the real views
